PORT.description: Public HTTP port. Railway routes the public domain to this port. Keep it equal to PDF2ZH_SERVER_PORT.

PDF2ZH_SERVER_PORT.description: Port the Web UI binds inside the container. Must match PORT (the public domain target). Defaults to 8080.

PDF2ZH_OLLAMA.description: Use the bundled Ollama sibling service as the translation engine (opt-in). Default off: the app uses its built-in default engine (SiliconFlow Free). Set true and pull a model to translate fully locally.

PDF2ZH_OLLAMA_HOST.description: Ollama API base URL. Auto-linked to the sibling Ollama service's private domain over :11434.

PDF2ZH_OLLAMA_MODEL.description: Ollama model to translate with (e.g. qwen3:8b, gemma2, llama3.2). No model is pre-pulled — pull one first (ollama pull <model>), then set it here or in the Web UI Settings.
